-77.33040,38.94820.name: Virginia Center for Reproductive Medicine
-77.33040,38.94820.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Fady I. Sharara, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-6.00124,37.38127.name: Ginemed
-6.00124,37.38127.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-81.09213,32.07901.name: F3EA, Inc.
-81.09213,32.07901.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-60.65462,-32.94460.name: Fertya
-60.65462,-32.94460.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.fertya.com.ar. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-77.05000,38.90070.name: Arnold & Porter — agricultural biotechnology practice
-77.05000,38.90070.desc: A law firm advising on agricultural biotechnology regulation, whose published client work and regulatory comments are part of the public record of how rules get shaped. Filings made by counsel on behalf of a company are searchable, and they say things companies do not say in their own name.

12.52000,55.78000.name: Novo Holdings
12.52000,55.78000.desc: The investment company controlling Novo Nordisk and holding stakes across biotechnology, ultimately owned by a Danish foundation. Foundation ownership means the profits fund research rather than shareholders, which is a genuinely different structure from the rest of the sector.

-0.09000,51.10000.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew — Millennium Seed Bank
-0.09000,51.10000.desc: The world’s largest wild plant seed bank, focused on wild relatives and endangered flora rather than crops. The wild relatives this map describes taking up engineered genes are the same material stored here, and a bank of what a population used to be is the only reference a later change can be measured against.
